notes: §1985:XIV.3.2.4 GR6: with OUTPUT "the logical paths are deactivated for all destinations specified by the content of each occurrence of data-name-5 up to and including the occurrence specified by the content of data-name-1". CommunicationBinder.BindPath binds DISABLE OUTPUT to CommunicationPath.Output (SR3 refused as COBOL6170), CommunicationEmitter.Emit calls MessageControl.Disable, and MessageControlSession.SetOutput disables occurrences 1..DESTINATION COUNT only (ValidCount: a count outside 1..OCCURS is 30, no action, Table 1), error key 1 unknown / 5 already disabled, status 20/15/80; no edition reads here, the facility gate is VersionConformancePass. The witness disables D1-D2 of three with count 2 and SEND shows D3 still enabled (10, 220). Probes at 85: (a/f) count 0, 4 over OCCURS 3 and 9999 each 30; MOVE -1 stores 1 (unsigned count); (b) count 3 with D3 already disabled 15 '005'; unknown ZZ + already-disabled D1 80 '15'; unknown + newly disabled 20 '10'; (c) DISABLE refused COBOL0902 at 2014 and 2023, obsolete warning COBOL0903 at 2002; (d,e) not applicable: no operand class or file reaches GR6.
